Store in airtight containers. Protect from light. USP 31 (Meperidine Hydrochloride). A fine white odourless crystalline powder. Very soluble in water; soluble in alcohol; sparingly soluble in ether. pH of a 5% solution in water is about 5. Protect from light. Incompatibility. Solutions of pethidine hydrochloride are acid- ic.
